I agree to not drive a company vehicle until such time that I obtain approval to do so. I also agree to notify my supervisor and the Safety Department should my license be suspended. responses.activity-before-incident: Employee was assigned to monitor winch cable on head pulley of grain belt elevator as they were attempting to pull in a new belt.
responses.what-happened: The employee attempted to move the cable back to the center of the head pulley. The employee grabbed the cable with both hands and attempted to move the cable when it slipped off the edge of the head pulley pinning both hands to the elevator housing of the grain elevator.
